full_judgment: 12. The learned Assistant-Attorney General has produced a chassis Book issued by the Japan Automobile Association for a period covering from 1987-1991 and submitted that the particular Chassis number that has been mentioned in the instant Invoice, Bill of Lading and other shipping documents is not available in this Chassis Book and as such the presumption is that this particular chassis mentioned in those documents was manufactured even before 1987 and that is why this particular chassis number does not appear from the entries of this book.
